# gramlot-examples 0.2.12

- Use the shared IndexPage for the gallery, with footer controls, persisted themes/layout, iframe tabs and the optional inspector.
- Show the host language source first and a separate Logic tab when present; keep server setup in the server documentation.
- Make lesson introductions shorter and explicit about their library scope while preserving the release sequence.
- Include lifecycle, attribute projection and local file exchange examples.
- Initialize the native multiple-select list directly, preserving list semantics with recursive Bag conversion.

Qualification: 62 JavaScript tests, 16 Python tests and 53 subtests; all 41 Python and 41 JavaScript example interactions pass in Chromium. Requires the core release. The Date/Decimal authoring exercise remains deferred pending Bag #69.
